recipe: 12-byte header 28 b5 2f fd a0 + u32 LE byte count + u24 LE (count*8+1), then the payload as one raw last block (META.json frame_recipe)

rows.result: header cannot be built: count*8+1 exceeds the 3-byte block header (21-bit count)

binding_bound: 131,072 bytes (128 KiB) for one raw block: zstd Block_Maximum_Size = min(Window_Size, 128 KiB), and descriptor a0 sets Single_Segment so Window_Size = the content size; the 21-bit block-size field (max 2,097,151) and the 4-byte frame-content-size field (max 4 GiB - 1) are both looser and never bind
page_cap: a page is at most 12,000 characters, so at most 48,000 bytes: the bound above binds no page
